text:
pager-bot: Pager — 4 alerts in 12m: model-worker OOMs on redwood-eu-prod-rt2. Severity: P2. Links: https://runbooks.redwood/runbooks/model-worker-oom | Bridge: https://meet.redwood/infra-bridge-411223344

maya: I’m unexpectedly delayed (train stuck) and will be offline from 22:15 UTC. Got paged — looks like OOM cascade. Need handoff ASAP for overnight. cc @sam @li @jorge

sam: I can take until 23:00 UTC then I’m in a call. Quick ask: any recent model changes or is this memory leak? First glance at metrics shows a spike post-deploy 20:40.

li: grabbing logs. can do 22:50-02:30 if someone covers 00:30-01:00 deployment. prefer to avoid full midnight stretch.

jorge: I can swap 01:00-05:00 and cancel my nonessential maintenance. happy to handle 00:30 deploy if li is primary at 00:00.

nina: I’m on-call backup but hesitating to take the full midnight — can cover 03:30 onward. :thumbsup:

maya: proposed: sam 22:15-23:00, li 23:00-00:45, jorge 00:45-05:00, nina shadow 03:30+. If anyone needs to reorder for deploy windows speak now.

sam: ack. current impact: transient timeouts on embedding endpoints, median latency x1.5, some 503s. CS notified, they’re asking if SLA breach likely.

li: runbook steps I'm running: 1) capture heap pprof, 2) rotate worker pool on canary, 3) apply temporary pod memory cap, 4) open fallback variant. Using:
```
kubectl -n inference exec -c monitor redwood-eu-prod-rt2 -- sh -c "curl -sS http://localhost:6060/debug/pprof/heap > /tmp/heap-$(date +%s).pprof"
kubectl -n inference rollout restart deployment/model-worker-eu --selector=tier=canary
```

li: noticed a runaway jvm thread in a subset of pods; capturing heap now. Canary restart in progress.

ops-bot: Incident created: INC-20260422-011 | severity=P2 | primary_oncall=sam | secondaries=li,jorge | bridge=https://meet.redwood/infra-bridge-411223344 | runbook=model-worker-oom

jorge: on the bridge 00:40 to sync with li and take over 00:45. If canary fails we’ll fail to fallback variant model-v2-approx per runbook.

sam: handoff in 5. dropping pod list & current backlog numbers to the bridge. note: a couple enterprise customers (Acct: NovaDynamics, Fluxware) hit increased retries; CS is drafting comms.

li: 23:12 update: canary showing lower heap growth, backlog dropping from 90% to 55%. continuing watch. scaling policy in play but holding automatic scale to avoid thundering.

jorge: 00:46 taking over primary. li, keep your logs, I’ll hold bridge until 05:00 and push a short summary to ops afterward.

nina: thanks. I’ll be ready for 03:30 takeover and will assemble affected-customer list for post-incident follow-up.

pager-bot: 3 follow-up alerts (reduced). Incident INC-20260422-011 status=mitigated(partial) | next-update=03:30 UTC

maya: thanks team. I’ll add a note to the oncall rota about the last-minute swap and flag for a follow-up P1 if memory regression continues. Please put timeline and commands used into the incident doc.
